scope.principle: Automated protocol readiness is not evidence that a human review, market test, permission review, application, merge, or deployment occurred.

blindSpots.label: Target-role specificity is tested against real opportunities
blindSpots.risk: A coherent general portfolio can still fail to answer the vocabulary, responsibilities, and proof expectations of an actual opening.
requiredEvidence: documented proof matches and proof gaps
antiGaming: Do not substitute role archetypes, invented postings, or portfolio-authored criteria for real market evidence.
blindSpots.stopRule: Pass the human gate only after five real roles are scored from the public portfolio and every material gap has a disposition.
blindSpots.nextAction: Supply five current job descriptions and run the role-fit scorecard without changing the site between individual reviews.

blindSpots.label: Independent holdouts test comprehension without author briefing
blindSpots.owner: Jamie Burkart with an independent reviewer coordinator
blindSpots.risk: Agents and collaborators who already know the archive can mistake familiarity for public comprehension.
requiredEvidence: anonymous role, value, proof, and next-action answers
antiGaming: Do not count an authoring agent, portfolio collaborator, or coached reviewer as an independent holdout.
blindSpots.stopRule: Pass only when at least three unfamiliar reviewers independently recover the role, differentiated value, three proofs, and next action.
blindSpots.nextAction: Run the public-only holdout protocol and retain aggregate answers without reviewer names.

blindSpots.label: Individual contribution provenance remains distinct from project existence
blindSpots.risk: A source may prove that a collective project existed or succeeded without proving Jamie's exact role, authority, or implementation work.
requiredEvidence: independent or collaborator corroboration with publication permission
antiGaming: Do not inherit individual credit from project existence, collective outputs, or later outcomes.
blindSpots.stopRule: A role claim advances only when project evidence and Jamie-role evidence are separately recorded and any collaborator-sensitive wording has permission.
blindSpots.nextAction: Request bounded proof notes for the five priority projects in the contribution matrix.

blindSpots.label: Outputs, observed outcomes, and causality boundaries remain separate
blindSpots.owner: Jamie Burkart with an evidence reviewer
blindSpots.risk: Usable outputs may be clear while adoption, decision change, durability, and Jamie's causal contribution remain under-evidenced.
requiredEvidence: an attribution boundary and open outcome question
antiGaming: Do not turn chronology, response totals, allocations, enactments, or continued existence into sole causality.
blindSpots.stopRule: Publish an outcome only when its source, unit, date, and attribution boundary can be stated together.
blindSpots.nextAction: Close one outcome question for each leading case study before adding any broader impact language.

blindSpots.label: Technical claims point to inspectable implementation evidence
blindSpots.owner: Jamie Burkart with a technical reviewer
blindSpots.risk: The civic and operational narrative can eclipse architecture, implementation decisions, constraints, failure recovery, and current technical practice.
requiredEvidence: an inspectable artifact or bounded protected review
one operating constraint or failure-recovery example
antiGaming: Do not treat a technology list, source list, repository name, or database count as an implementation account.
blindSpots.stopRule: A technical claim is ready when a reviewer can trace system, decision, constraint, artifact, and Jamie's role without private access.
blindSpots.nextAction: Prepare a technical evidence packet for the five systems in the matrix, beginning with HJE and Technical Operations synthesis debt.

blindSpots.label: Collaboration maps preserve shared credit and Jamie's bounded role
blindSpots.owner: Jamie Burkart with named collaborators where approved
blindSpots.risk: Protecting collective credit can leave Jamie vague, while strengthening Jamie's role can accidentally erase collaborators.
antiGaming: Do not make Jamie legible by making collaborators disappear or by publishing names and quotations without permission.
blindSpots.stopRule: A role map is publishable only when Jamie's contribution and collective credit are both specific and permissions are explicit.
blindSpots.nextAction: Build collaborator-safe role maps for five priority collective projects and request corrections before quotation.

blindSpots.label: Visual proof requires evidence, rights, consent, and caption readiness
blindSpots.owner: Jamie Burkart with a photo editor and rights reviewer
blindSpots.risk: The textual argument is much stronger than the visual argument, while archive custody alone does not establish republication rights or participant consent.
requiredEvidence: one candidate set per leading case study
a source-backed caption explaining evidentiary value
antiGaming: Do not mark an image ready because it is attractive, available, historically interesting, or already in Jamie's archive.
blindSpots.stopRule: A visual package is ready only when candidate, evidentiary value, rights, consent, crop, alt text, and caption all pass review.
blindSpots.nextAction: Produce one unmistakable visual proof package for each of the five leading case studies.

blindSpots.label: The longitudinal practice thesis remains useful without flattening projects
blindSpots.owner: Jamie Burkart with an independent editor
blindSpots.risk: A compelling lifelong pattern can flatten distinct projects, places, communities, collaborators, and historical conditions into one retrospective story.
requiredEvidence: at least five separately sourced projects
antiGaming: Do not use thematic resemblance as proof of one continuous program, method, or causal intention.
blindSpots.stopRule: Keep the thesis on hold until an independent editor can state both the shared practice and the meaningful differences among projects.
blindSpots.nextAction: Test one diagram and one 150-word synthesis against the anti-flattening questions without adding either to the site.

blindSpots.label: Archive work has a stopping rule that returns effort to applications
blindSpots.risk: An effectively infinite archive can absorb time that should produce applications, outreach, interviews, and professional conversations.
antiGaming: Do not count sources found, claims matured, pages edited, or eval points gained as job-search outcomes.
blindSpots.stopRule: After 90 minutes, file noncritical proof debt as an inquiry and return to application, outreach, or conversation unless a factual or safety blocker prevents submission.
blindSpots.nextAction: Apply the cadence to the next five real opportunities and review whether research time displaced outward action.

blindSpots.label: Agency language is direct without erasing collective boundaries
blindSpots.owner: Jamie Burkart with an independent editor
blindSpots.risk: Collective-credit care can become self-erasure, while stronger agency language can become unsupported ownership or causality.
requiredEvidence: an explicit collective, authority, or causality boundary where needed
antiGaming: Do not repair understatement by deleting collaborators, claiming formal authority, or weakening evidence and causality boundaries.
blindSpots.stopRule: A sentence passes when Jamie's action, object, and purpose are direct and the strongest necessary boundary remains adjacent or canonical.
blindSpots.nextAction: Run an independent sentence-level review of the homepage, resume, and five leading case studies for both self-erasure and inflation.

blindSpots.label: Branch-local readiness remains distinct from merged and deployed reality
blindSpots.owner: Jamie Burkart as repository and deployment owner
blindSpots.risk: A branch can pass every automated gate while parallel pull requests, supersession ambiguity, unmerged code, or an unverified deploy prevent the public system from receiving the work.
requiredEvidence: postdeploy route, indexing, canonical, and resume verification
antiGaming: Do not call a branch-local score merged, deployed, production-approved, or postdeploy-verified.
blindSpots.stopRule: Production readiness is complete only after PR ownership is resolved, Jamie approves the exact SHA, deployment succeeds, and postdeploy checks pass.
blindSpots.nextAction: Inventory every PR targeting develop, choose the production candidate, and record supersession before requesting deploy approval.
